cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.description: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.

cards.name: Shelmet
cards.description: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

cards.name: Gardevoir
cards.description: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Accelgor
cards.description: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

cards.name: Archeops
cards.description: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.description: Inhaled air is heated in the flame sac in its body to an intense fire over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.description: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.description: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

cards.name: Combusken
cards.description: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

cards.name: Blaziken
cards.description: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch it foes.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.description: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.description: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.description: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower's coming bloom.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.description: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.description: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.description: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.description: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.description: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can melt away into water.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.description: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.description: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.description: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

cards.name: Glaceon
cards.description: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.description: They warn other of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.description: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.description: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas surrounding them.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.description: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon's habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.description: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food—peat moss.

cards.name: Swanna
cards.description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.description: If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.description: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

cards.name: Minun
cards.description: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.description: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.description: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.description: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.description: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.description: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.description: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

cards.name: Espeon
cards.description: Its fur is so sensitive, it can sense minute shifts in the air and predict the weather.

cards.name: Slowking
cards.description: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.description: It binds itself to trees on marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.description: Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

cards.name: Yamask
cards.description: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

cards.name: Cofagrigus
cards.description: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.description: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.description: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.description: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.description: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

cards.name: Timburr
cards.description: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

cards.name: Gurdurr
cards.description: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.

cards.name: Leafeon
cards.description: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.description: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

cards.name: Umbreon
cards.description: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.description: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.description: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.description: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.description: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.description: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.description: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

cards.name: Dwebble
cards.description: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.description: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.description: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.description: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

cards.name: Escavalier
cards.description: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

cards.name: Klink
cards.description: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

cards.name: Klang
cards.description: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

cards.name: Klinklang
cards.description: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

cards.name: Crustle
cards.description: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.description: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.description: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

cards.name: Blissey
cards.description: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.description: Its tongue is just like a human's. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.description: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.description: It has a black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.description: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

cards.name: Haxorus
cards.description: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.description: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
